title: The Two Truths Doctrine
summary: Nāgārjuna's distinction between conventional reality (saṃvṛti-satya)—where language, empirical causality, and ethical practices operate coherently—and ultimate reality (paramārtha-satya), the direct realization of emptiness. Demonstrates that emptiness does not annihilate the everyday world, but is the very ground that makes change, moral agency, and liberation possible.
